headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: H1 FY27 revenue increased 20.3% YoY to INR 1,887 cr, with international operations contributing approximately 54% of revenue.
Profitability remained healthy, with Q2 EBITDA increasing 20% YoY to INR 145 cr, translating into a margin of 14.5%.
For H1 FY27, EBITDA rose 20.7% YoY to INR 261 cr, with a margin of 13.8%, while PAT increased 29.3% YoY to INR 195 cr.
The order book reached INR 20,207 cr, providing visibility of over four times annual revenue, while H1 order intake stood at approximately INR 5,200 cr.
valuation: O&M contributed approximately 18% of revenue against a medium-term target of 20%.
Management continues to target a 20% revenue contribution, with completed EPC projects progressively moving into their operating phase. 5.
Key projects advance towards commissioning: Al Haer STP commissioning is targeted for Q4FY27, while Perur desalination construction and mechanical erection continue to progress.
watch: Key wins included the Kuwait desalination project and Reliance Industries’ desalination and remineralisation plants at Jamnagar, alongside projects in the UAE, Europe and domestic municipal markets.
Management reiterated its medium-term outlook of 15–20% revenue CAGR and 13–15% EBITDA margins, supported by technology-led projects, international execution and recurring O&M revenues.
